      HOW PRICES GET HERE

      Browse the FM, prices fill in.

      Players open Live FM Scanner, share their game window and walk the Free Market as usual. Every shop they open is read on their own computer; structured listing data and small item icon crops are shared after your agreement. Nothing clicks or reads game memory.

      1. Asking priceWhat a shop lists an item for. Lowest and typical (median) are shown separately.
      2. Reviewed saleA reported sale reviewed with supporting evidence. Client OCR alone does not verify a trade.
      3. FreshnessEvery number shows when it was last seen. Observed listings are not guaranteed available inventory.

                NEW MEGAPHONE

                Write your megaphone

                Sign in under Player Stores before checkout. Packages buy campaign time in a fair rotation, not continuous display or a guaranteed number of views. Stripe sandbox mode stays on until production is configured.

                  Preview

                  Secure checkout by Stripe. While the site is in test mode no real money is taken; use Stripe’s test card 4242 4242 4242 4242.

                  HOW IT WORKS
                  • Rotation: every live megaphone gets an equal turn under the search bar, 8 seconds each, in a loop.
                  • Price: Basic $1.99 / 30 minutes · Premium $3.99 / 2 hours · Featured $5.99 / 6 hours.
                  • Your time: the hours you buy are real time in that rotation, counted from when it goes live.
                  • Review first: after payment a moderator approves it; your time starts then, not at payment.
                  • Slots: at most 8 run at once. If all are taken, yours is queued and starts as soon as one frees up, so you always get the full time.
                  • Rules: no links, no real-money trading, nothing offensive. Rejected megaphones are refunded.

                              ITEM DATABASE

                              Catalog updates

                              Approved sources can be checked daily. Imports preserve the catalog and enter release review; source permission and a verified backup are prerequisites.

                                ITEM DATABASE

                                Community items to review

                                Names read from shops that are not in the catalog. Correct the name, add the game item ID if you know it, and verify.

                                  Guided Cash Shop candidate capture

                                  Read one item card at a time, review uncertain names and NX prices, then submit structured fields for admin review. This is not exhaustive catalog synchronization. No game frames or raw OCR text are uploaded.

                                  Share a window, then drag around one item card.

                                  Privacy, sources & limitations
                                  Screen reading happens in your browser with Tesseract.js (loaded from jsDelivr). Nothing clicks, types or reads game memory. Live FM Scanner sends item names, per-item prices, quantities, stats read from tooltips, shop titles and FM room names, plus small item pictures for items without one, under an anonymous ID. My Store submits OCR-corroborated reports only if you turn that on; public sale valuation still requires admin evidence review. Your Discord webhook stays in page memory and goes only to Discord.
                                  Item data: names, IDs, categories, base stats and item pictures are MapleStory Classic World game data from OSMS Data Explorer, used under CC BY 4.0 (existing coverage unverified). NX coverage is unverified. Cash Shop candidates and permitted source imports need release review; incomplete pages never prove exhaustive coverage. Game data and images © NEXON. NiaDB (meowdb.com) data is not used: its reuse policy requires permission first.
                                  Prices are what shops ask unless marked as a reviewed sale. OCR can misread; listings must read the same twice before they count, and contributor accounts are not proof of independent player identities. Hidden tabs are throttled by the browser.
